cancellationPolicies.label: Free Cancellation rates
cancellationPolicies.description: If you cancel your booking before 23:59 4th Nov 2025 (AEST) your deposit will be refunded to your payment card. If you cancel after 23:59 4th Nov 2025 (AEST) or in the event of a no-show, your deposit will not be refunded and the total of the first night's accommodation will be charged to your payment card, unless otherwise stated (see 'Things to Note' information). Please note that cancellations must be made directly within your booking in My Account.

dorms.name: Deluxe 6 Bed Mixed Dorm Ensuite
dorms.description: Dormitory style and range in size from 2 beds upwards.  They offer mixed accommodation.
dorms.labelDescription: Enjoy some privacy with curtains on each bunk of our 6-share room with ensuite. Featuring a balcony and a view, this room has A /C and is equipped with a hair dryer, personal power points, bed lights, personal shelves and a secure locker units.

paymentProcedure.label: Deposit only
paymentProcedure.description:
Deposit only
Your deposit will be non-refundable unless the Standard Flexible Booking option is available and you select it. T&C apply.

privates.name: Deluxe Double Bed Private Ensuite
privates.description: In order to secure a Private Room, you will need to book the entire room.
privates.labelDescription: Our first floor Private King + Ensuite is the perfect getaway for a couple or with a friend.  Have your own private space but enjoy the vibe of the hostel.  The super comfy King bed splits to twin single. Advise if twin single is required.
